title: probatio mutate.diff
description: Mutates only the lines changed since --since and names the survivors on those lines. --since is HEAD by default (uncommitted edits and untracked files); one ref such as main is read from its merge-base with HEAD, so only this branch's changes are scored; A..B starts at A and A...B at the merge-base of A and B, and B must be HEAD. Test code (tests/, benches/, test files, #[cfg(test)] and #[test] items) is skipped unless --include-tests, and testLinesSkipped counts it. Mutants that do not build are listed under unbuildable, never as survivors. Output goes to <project root>/.probatio/diff/<package path> unless --out or PROBATIO_DIR says otherwise. Each call starts from a fresh <out>/run, so a test added since the last call counts, unless --continue: then the results of the last call are kept when it scored the same mutants (same changed lines, same text), and the call scores the next --max-mutants that have no result. When there are more mutants than --max-mutants, they are spread across the changed files (round-robin by file, one per changed line first), and nextCall is the same call with --continue. --estimate scores nothing: it returns the mutant count and a time estimate (from <out>/cost.json, written by the last call with the same suite command, else from two timed suite runs in a mutant tree). --budget-ms or --max-minutes stops starting mutants once that much time has passed since the call began (the baseline counts); at least one is scored. --low-priority runs the suites and builds below normal priority. Line numbers are working-tree lines at call time; the mutant tree is restored from a snapshot taken then, so a later edit does not change what is scored. Every command prints one JSON object. schemaVersion changes when a field is renamed, removed, or changes meaning. A new field does not change it.

mutantCount.description: Mutants this reply's counts cover: those scored by earlier calls this one continued, and this call's share.

notRun.description: Mutants on the changed lines with no result yet. nextCall continues them.

equivalent.description: Present when a findings add --status equivalent record matches this survivor: its reason.

fullList.description: <out>/survivors.json with every survivor and did-not-build row, when the reply lists only 10 of either.

estimate.description: --estimate only: basis (last run or tree check), perMutantMs, baselineMs, treeCheckMs, thisCallMs, allMs, calls, workers, setupMs.
